reason: The cited evidence (E1) confirms that increasing Al content transforms part of the FCC phase to BCC in AlxCr1−xCoFeNi, but it provides no data on electron concentration, lattice parameters, high-temperature strength, environmental resistance, radiation tolerance, or cryogenic toughness. Thus, only the structural transition premise is supported, while the mechanistic and property-related premises lack specific prior evidence.
